fact: Liverpool Football Club was founded in 1892 by John Houlding after Everton left Anfield following a rent dispute.
Anfield has been Liverpool's home ground since the club was founded in 1892.
After the Anfield Road Stand expansion in 2024, Anfield holds around 61,000 fans.
"You'll Never Walk Alone" is the club's anthem and is sung by fans before every home game.
The Liver Bird is the symbol on Liverpool's crest and comes from the coat of arms of the city of Liverpool.
Liverpool fans and the team are often called 'The Reds' because of the club's red home kit.
Bill Shankly managed Liverpool from 1959 to 1974 and transformed the club into a major force in English football.
Bob Paisley won three European Cups as Liverpool manager (1977 1978 and 1981).
Jurgen Klopp managed Liverpool from 2015 to 2024 and won the Champions League in 2019 and the Premier League in 2019-20.
Arne Slot replaced Jurgen Klopp in 2024 and won the Premier League in his first season (2024-25).
Liverpool have won 20 English league titles.
Liverpool have won the European Cup / Champions League six times: 1977 1978 1981 1984 2005 and 2019.
Liverpool's 2019-20 Premier League title was the club's first league title in 30 years.
In the 2005 Champions League final in Istanbul Liverpool came back from 3-0 down at half-time against AC Milan and won on penalties.
Steven Gerrard captained Liverpool for over a decade and lifted the Champions League trophy in 2005.
Ian Rush is Liverpool's all-time top goalscorer with 346 goals.
Ian Callaghan holds the record for the most appearances for Liverpool with 857 games.
Mohamed Salah joined Liverpool from AS Roma in 2017 and became one of the club's greatest ever goalscorers.
The Merseyside derby is the match between Liverpool and Everton the two clubs from the city of Liverpool.
The Hillsborough disaster in 1989 claimed the lives of 97 Liverpool supporters; the club and fans campaigned for decades for justice.
